bridge.note: 19 Nov 2026 14:00 KST, enrique: 'being able to bridge between the chains we operate in would be useful', 'same goes for in and out of polygon', 'also build being able to bridge with base'. Moves money between our own wallets only (src/bridge). order: null = nothing happens. An order is { "id": "a-new-name", "from": place, "to": place, "usd": 15 to 250, "mode": "dry" | "go" }; places: hyperliquid, polymarket, base, solana-perps, solana-spot-rules, solana-spot-copy (every pair but Solana to Solana; sending FROM base needs a little ETH on Base for gas; the Base wallet is made on the server the first time an order names it). 'dry' prices the move and says what it would do (status bridge.now), signing nothing. 'go' needs enrique's own word for THAT move, after a clean dry run: test part first, the rest only once the test arrived. Each id runs once. Optional in an order: "token": "USDC" | "SOL" (which one leaves a Solana wallet; default USDC for perps, SOL for the spot wallets) and "keepUsd": N (then usd is the MOST that moves and N dollars of that token stay behind, on top of gas). "dryRuns": [orders] prices several moves side by side (status bridge.dryRuns); those can never go. Put an order in its own commit, only after the code is live.
